title: Check a document
lede: Bank statements, letters and invoices as PDF or Word. We check how the file was made and what it says, as two separate reports.
noSemanticFindings: No scam language found in the file's text.

summary.clean: Nothing stood out in how the file was made or in what it says.
summary.counts: {structural} thing(s) found in how the file was made, {semantic} in what it says.

noExtractedText: No readable text was found in this file.

verdict.safe: Nothing in the text stands out
verdict.suspicious: Some warning signs in the text

whatToDo.suspicious: Verify before you act on this.

whatToDoBody.safe: A clean check isn't proof. If this document asks for money or credentials, confirm it independently first.
whatToDoBody.suspicious: Confirm this document with the organisation it claims to be from, using contact details you find yourself.
whatToDoBody.scam: Don't pay, sign or share credentials because of this file. Confirm it with the organisation it claims to be from, using contact details you find yourself.
